patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,86 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.frame_scores = []
+        self.current_frame = 0
+        self.frame_rolls = []
+        self.is_tenth_frame = False
+        self.tenth_frame_rolls = []
+        self.game_over = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.game_over:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        
+        if pins < 0 or pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pins must be between 0 and 10")
+            
+        if not self.is_tenth_frame:
+            # Regular frames (1-9)
+            self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+            
+            # Check if frame is complete
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 2 or self.frame_rolls[0] == 10:  # Strike or two rolls
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                if self.current_frame == 10:
+                    self.is_tenth_frame = True
+                    self.tenth_frame_rolls = [pins]
+                else:
+                    self.rolls.extend(self.frame_rolls)
+                    self.frame_rolls = []
+            else:
+                self.rolls.append(pins)
+        else:
+            # Tenth frame handling
+            self.tenth_frame_rolls.append(pins)
+            
+            # Check if tenth frame is complete
+            if len(self.tenth_frame_rolls) == 3:
+                # All rolls done
+                self.rolls.extend(self.tenth_frame_rolls)
+                self.game_over = True
+            elif len(self.tenth_frame_rolls) == 2:
+                # Two rolls done, check if third is needed
+                roll1, roll2 = self.tenth_frame_rolls[0], self.tenth_frame_rolls[1]
+                if roll1 == 10 or (roll1 + roll2) == 10:
+                    # Need third roll for strike or spare
+                    pass
+                else:
+                    # Open frame, game over
+                    self.rolls.extend(self.tenth_frame_rolls)
+                    self.game_over = True
+            else:
+                self.rolls.append(pins)
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.game_over and not (self.is_tenth_frame and len(self.tenth_frame_rolls) >= 2):
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        for frame in range(10):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                break
+                
+            if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:  # Strike
+                # Strike: 10 + next two rolls
+                if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                    total_score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 1] + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                else:
+                    # This shouldn't happen in a complete game
+                    total_score += 10
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                frame_score = self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                if frame_score == 10:  # Spare
+                    # Spare: 10 + next roll
+                    if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                        total_score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                    else:
+                        total_score += 10
+                else:  # Open frame
+                    total_score += frame_score
+                roll_index += 2
+                
+        return total_score
